title: Chiller plant — sequence of operations
note: PRD-SETPOINT-SIM P3. Curated. A threshold is never typed here: a condition names a limit of the conv limits registry (limit), an engine parameter (param) or a value the engine derives (derived); tools/build-sequences.mjs resolves it. A delay or hysteresis that no source states is ASSUMED and says why.

basis.ref: ASHRAE Guideline 36-2021, chilled-water plant sequences (developed under ASHRAE RP-1711)
basis.use: the structure: modes with entry, ordered actions and exit; staging on capacity and on supply-temperature error; failsafe staging on a trip
basis.limits: the numbers come from this plant's engine and limits registry, not from the guideline

plant: primary-secondary chilled water with a decoupler; one primary pump per running chiller train; one condenser pump per chiller (js/conv-engine.js hydronic fleet); N+1 chillers

modes.label: Normal — lead/lag staging

entry.text: plant enabled and every running chiller proven (CHW and CDW flow proven, no fault)

actions: run the fewest chillers that carry the load: n = ceil(load / unit rating), the engine's own rule
hold CHW supply at its setpoint (each running chiller's own controller)
rotate the lead chiller by run hours (lead/lag)

exit.text: CHW supply above its high warning
one fewer chiller would carry the load

exit.event: a condenser pump trips or its flow switch opens

exit.text: evaporator flow below the minimum (% of design)
entering condenser water below the minimum
condenser water supply above its high warning

exit.event: supply to the chiller plant lost

assumed.delay_s 900: 15 min staging delay: common practice to avoid short-cycling; no source in this repo states it
assumed.value 90: 10 % hysteresis below full load so a stage-down does not stage straight back up; no source in this repo states it
assumed.delay_s 300: 5 min confirmation of a high condenser water temperature; no source in this repo states it

modes.label: Stage up — start the next chiller

entry.text: from Normal (capacity or CHWS error) or from a trip (immediately, no delay)

actions: select the lag chiller with the fewest run hours that is available
open its CHW and CDW isolation valves
start its primary pump and its condenser pump
prove CHW and CDW flow on both flow switches
start the chiller and load it (soft-load ramp)

exit.event: the new chiller is proven running

modes.label: Stage down — stop one chiller

entry.text: from Normal when one fewer chiller carries the load

actions: unload and stop the lag chiller with the most run hours
after its pump-down delay, stop its primary and condenser pumps
close its CHW and CDW isolation valves

exit.event: the chiller is stopped and isolated

modes.label: Chiller trip — failsafe stage up

entry.event: a running chiller trips on its own safety (fault)

actions: lock out the tripped chiller and raise an alarm
stage up the next available chiller at once (no staging delay)
the remaining chillers carry the load until it is proven; CHW supply rises while capacity is short

modes.label: Loss of condenser water

entry.event: a condenser pump trips or the condenser flow switch opens

actions: the chiller on that pump trips on its condenser flow switch (one condenser pump per chiller)
raise an alarm on the pump and on the chiller

modes.label: Low evaporator flow — minimum-flow bypass

entry.text: evaporator flow below the minimum (% of design)

actions: open the minimum-flow bypass until each running evaporator sees its minimum flow (the engine's DP bypass: Q_bp = Q_min - Q_load)
if the flow switch still opens, the chiller trips on its own low-flow safety

exit.event: evaporator flow at or above the minimum

modes.label: Low entering condenser water — tower bypass

entry.text: entering condenser water below the minimum

actions: slow the tower fans to minimum speed
modulate the tower 3-way bypass to hold entering condenser water at the minimum (the engine's tower 3-way valve)

exit.event: entering condenser water at or above the minimum

modes.label: High condenser water — unload
actions: run every available tower cell, fans at full speed
close the tower 3-way bypass
limit chiller demand so condenser pressure stays below the high-pressure cutout

assumed.delay_s 60: 1 min confirmation of a CHW supply high alarm; no source in this repo states it

modes.label: Power failure — staggered restart

entry.event: supply to the chiller plant lost (utility lost before the standby supply takes the load)

actions: every chiller stops; CHW supply rises while no chiller runs
on the return of supply, prove CHW and CDW flow, then restart the chillers one at a time
wait the restart stagger between two chiller starts so the supply is not hit by every compressor inrush at once

exit.event: the chillers the load needs are proven running

modes.notModelled: whether the CHW pumps ride through on UPS, and the chiller's own rapid-restart time, are not modelled in this plant

assumed.stagger_s 120: 2 min between chiller starts; no source in this repo states it

modes.label: Emergency cooling — all available chillers

entry.text: the chillers still available cannot carry the load

actions: start every available chiller and its pumps
suspend stage-down
hold the CHW supply setpoint at design; no upward reset
alarm to the operator; exit only on an operator reset

exit.text: CHW supply back below its high warning, then an operator reset

modes.notModelled: thermal storage: this plant has none in the engine, so there is no TES discharge step
